title: Gain-Scheduled PID Autotuner
text: Automatically tune PID gains at multiple operating points, 9 inputs, 5 outputs, {Controller type} sets PID controller actions; {Form} sets the pID controller form, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets the sample time of PID controller, {Data Type} sets the floating point precision, {Tune at different sample time} enables tuning at different sample time from PID controller, {Tuning sample time (sec)} sets the sample time of tuning algorithm, {Integrator method} sets the discrete integration formula for integrator term Forward, {Filter method} sets the discrete integration formula for derivative filter term Forward, {Target bandwidth (rad/sec)} sets the target crossover frequency of tuned, {Target phase margin (degrees)} sets the target minimum phase margin of open-loop, {Experiment Mode} sets the perturbation signal type, {Plant Type} sets the stability of plant, {Plant Sign} sets the sign of plant, {Signal Amplitudes} sets the amplitude of perturbations, {Breakpoints} sets the gain scheduling breakpoints, {Use external signal} sets the breakpoints from input port, {Number of breakpoints}, {Gain index tolerance}, {Use y as scheduling variable} sets the schedule breakpoints using plant output, {Method of storing gains}, {P Gain initial conditions} sets the proportional gain initial value, {P Gain Parameter Name} sets the proportional gain data, {I Gain initial conditions} sets the integral gain initial value, {I Gain Parameter Name} sets the integral gain data, {D Gain initial conditions} sets the derivative gain initial value, {D Gain Parameter Name} sets the derivative gain data, {N Gain initial conditions} sets the filter gain initial value, {N Gain Parameter Name} sets the filter gain data, {Save breakpoints in gain array} sets the save breakpoints along with PID gains, {Method to trigger gain update} sets the update trigger method Detect change in PID, {Number of samples to delay update}, {P gain lookup method} sets the proportional gain lookup method Interpolation-Use End, {I gain lookup method} sets the integral gain lookup method Interpolation-Use End, {D gain lookup method} sets the derivative gain lookup method Interpolation-Use End, {N gain lookup method} sets the derivative filter gain lookup method Interpolation-Use End, {Saturate to max or min when overflows occur} sets the method of overflow action, {Lock output data type setting against changes by the fixed-point tools} sets the option to prevent fixed-point tools from overriding Output data, {Integer rounding mode} sets the rounding mode for fixed-point operations, {Output Signal Configuration} sets the provide control signal plus perturbation or perturbation only control action +, {Display Bode plot} plots estimated frequency response, {Baseline plant model} sets the baseline model for Bode plot and {Display gain surface plot}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Controller type
params.values: PID controller actions PIDN (default) | P | I | PI | PD | PDN | PID |...

params.name: Form
params.values: PID controller form Parallel (default) | Ideal

params.name: Sample time (-1 for inherited)
params.values: Sample time of PID controller 0.1 (default) | positive scalar | –1

params.name: Data Type
params.values: Floating point precision double (default) | single

params.name: Tune at different sample time
params.values: Enable tuning at different sample time from PID controller and experiment off (default) | on

params.name: Tuning sample time (sec)
params.values: Sample time of tuning algorithm 0.2 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Integrator method
params.values: Discrete integration formula for integrator term Forward Euler (default) | Backward Euler | Trapezoidal

params.name: Filter method
params.values: Discrete integration formula for derivative filter term Forward Euler (default) | Backward Euler | Trapezoidal

params.name: Target bandwidth (rad/sec)
params.values: Target crossover frequency of tuned response 1 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Target phase margin (degrees)
params.values: Target minimum phase margin of open-loop response 60 (default) | scalar in range 0–90

params.name: Experiment Mode
params.values: Perturbation signal type Superposition (default) | Sinestream | PRBS

params.name: Plant Type
params.values: Stability of plant Stable (default) | Integrating

params.name: Plant Sign
params.values: Sign of plant Positive (default) | Negative

params.name: Signal Amplitudes
params.values: Amplitude of perturbations 1 (default) | scalar | vector of length 5

params.name: Breakpoints
params.values: Gain scheduling breakpoints [1 2 3] (default) | vector

params.name: Use external signal
params.values: Specify breakpoints from input port off (default) | on

params.name: Number of breakpoints
params.values: Number of breakpoints 3 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Gain index tolerance
params.values: Gain index tolerance 1e-3 (default) | nonegative scalar

params.name: Use y as scheduling variable
params.values: Schedule breakpoints using plant output on (default) | off

params.name: Method of storing gains
params.values: Method of storing gains Internal to block (default) | Data store memory

params.name: P Gain initial conditions
params.values: Proportional gain initial value 0 (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: I Gain initial conditions
params.values: Integral gain initial value 0 (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: I Gain Parameter Name
params.values: Integral gain data name IGain (default) | string

params.name: D Gain initial conditions
params.values: Derivative gain initial value 0 (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: D Gain Parameter Name
params.values: Derivative gain data name DGain (default) | string

params.name: N Gain initial conditions
